findings: Desktop version string split across two constants — `jvmArgs` fallback `"2.4.0"` and `packageVersion = "2.4.0"` in `desktopApp/build.gradle.kts` are independent; a version bump that updates one but not the other will silently show the wrong version on the splash screen. Centralise both behind `project.version` at the root build script, or extract a local `val desktopAppVersion` and reference it from both places.

Logged-in user double-navigation race — `SplashFlow`'s `LaunchedEffect` collects effects for the full composition lifetime. A logged-in user tapping "Get Started" before the 2s timer fires generates `NavigateToAuth` immediately and `NavigateToHome` two seconds later; if the `LaunchedEffect` coroutine survives long enough after the first navigation, `replaceAll(HomeRoute.Root())` fires on the already-navigated stack. Guard with a `hasNavigated` flag or cancel the coroutine job after the first effect delivery.
